bundle.shortDescription: App store for Ubuntu: APT, Flatpak, Snap and AppImage in one place
bundle.longDescription: Browse, search and manage applications from APT, Flatpak, Snap and AppImage in a single app store, with a summary and a confirmation before every change. Installs keep going with the window closed and a notification tells you when they are done. The interface is in English, or in Italian when the system language is Italian.
